messages.subject: Executive Leadership Profile | GCC Country Strategy, ESG & Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Maira,

I am reaching out directly after an earlier message to another MA & Partners address did not complete delivery. Given your leadership of MA & Partners and the firm's executive-search reach across the UAE, wider Middle East, oil and gas, non-financial services and senior leadership appointments, I wanted to place my profile with you directly.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My scope spans ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, government and regulatory relations, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and country-facing coordination within a major international mining operation.

My work requires sustained engagement with ministries, regulators, public institutions, communities, industry bodies and senior corporate leadership. I coordinate complex matters across regulatory approvals, stakeholder commitments, reputation, social performance, sustainability, investment priorities and cross-functional operating teams. I also support governance and external positioning around a large solar and battery-storage platform and broader carbon-accounting work.

I am exploring senior mandates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC, including Country Director or Representative, Executive Director, Director or Head of Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, External Affairs, Stakeholder Engagement and Country Operations. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my current GCC executive CV. I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming searches where institutional leadership, government interface, ESG, stakeholder trust and disciplined country execution are core to the mandate.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | ESG | Corporate Affairs | Government Relations
